vocabulary_notes.relation_type_restraint: No ENSLAVES, COMMANDS_SLAVE_COMPANY, ALLY_OF, VOLUNTARILY_SUPPORTS, REBELS_AGAINST, RESISTS, OWNS_TERRITORY, or TRANSFERS_SOVEREIGNTY relation type was created, per the explicit hard rule. Territorial cessions (1667/1681/1681-Painan) are represented via RECOGNIZES_OFFICE_HOLDER (the ceding ruler recognizing VOC's resulting authority), not a fabricated CEDES_TERRITORY_TO or TRANSFERS_SOVEREIGNTY type. The armed enslaved company's command relationship is represented ONLY as a standalone observation (OBS_CONSTRAINED_AGENCY_ARMED_ENSLAVED_COMPANY), never as a relation.
vocabulary_notes.toll_relinquishment_relation_type_failur: The 1698 salimoet relinquishment (task item 6) could not be represented as its own directed relation without either inventing a new relation type or reversing COLLECTS_TOLL_FROM's own direction to mean 'relinquishes.' This artifact represents only the standing toll right itself (subject=Sillida regents as beneficiary, object=VOC, per the source's own 'enjoyed from the Company' framing), with the relation's own valid_to marking the relinquishment date -- the relinquishment ACT itself is a disclosed representational gap, directly parallel to Tiku V3's own T-04 (toll EXEMPTION) finding and to this artifact's own claim/control separation logic.
vocabulary_notes.constrained_agency_disclosure: The armed enslaved company's own political agency (loyalty, voluntary collaboration, resistance) is recorded as CANNOT_DETERMINE throughout, strictly separated from Radja doa Selas's own resistance_candidate=PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED (a different actor in the same 1687 episode). No relation forces a political-stance value onto the coerced company.

The existing COLLECTS_TOLL_FROM relation is unchanged -- it represents the long-standing right itself; the new RightModification represents the 1698 act of giving it up. CH-07 (DEC-09/DEC-10): CommandObservation migrating the artifact's own pre-existing OBS_CONSTRAINED_AGENCY_ARMED_ENSLAVED_COMPANY observation into the formal structured fields. coercion_status=COERCED is directly supported by the source's explicit 'Sclaven' (enslaved) status; ability_to_refuse and political_intent are CANNOT_DETERMINE because the original observation's own uncertainty_note states the company's agency beyond coerced deployment is undocumented -- not inferred beyond what the source says. No relation was added between ACTOR_VOC and ACTOR_ARMED_ENSLAVED_COMPANY_SILLIDA_MINE (the original observation explicitly notes none was created), so the R-REF-03 safety-critical collision check passes by construction, not by omission.
